description: As compliant until the key is stored. A runtime switch (#2893) then makes every signed call answer as in live_key_on_demo and the private WS close on auth, while the key keeps the id and secret it was stored with: the key was deleted at Bybit and never revoked locally.

expected.outcome: After the switch the self-check marks the key and its account invalid with an alert and disables trading there, while the other account stays verified. The check cannot verify withdrawal-off or the allowlist, so it counts as failed and the system is read-only (plan DC-04).
